title: Object cohomology is naturally the right derived section functor
statement: Let C be a small category, J a Grothendieck topology with sheafification for abelian groups, U an object of C, and q a natural number. Assume HasExt for the category of abelian sheaves, with all category and coefficient universes equal. The functor F -> H^q(U,F), obtained by evaluating the cohomology presheaf functor of [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology] at U, is naturally isomorphic to the q-th right derived functor of F -> F(U).

source.place: Section 01FT, definition of cohomology and cohomology over an object

proof.text: The sheafification additive adjunction, whiskered free-abelian/forgetful adjunction, and Yoneda give the private additive equivalence sectionsEquiv. Additivity is pointwise evaluation of sums of morphisms; naturality is homEquiv_naturality_right. NatIso.ofComponents gives sectionsIso identifying additive Hom from the sheafified free representable with sections at U.

Apply the fully proved generic comparison [lem-sc-ext-right-derived-hom] to the sheafified free abelian representable. Evaluation of cohomologyPresheafFunctor is definitionally its extFunctor. Derive sectionsIso in degree q using NatTrans.rightDerived on its hom and inv; rightDerived_comp and rightDerived_id show these are inverse. Compose the Ext comparison and this derived isomorphism.

proof_origin.place: Tag 01FT, equation-cohomology-object-site; representation and comparison proof formalized by N1

theorem nonempty_cohomologyPresheafFunctor_eval_iso_rightDerived
    {C : Type u} [SmallCategory C] (J : GrothendieckTopology C)
    [HasSheafify J AddCommGrpCat.{u}]
    [HasExt.{u} (Sheaf J AddCommGrpCat.{u})]
    (U : C) (q : ℕ) :
    Nonempty ((cohomologyPresheafFunctor J q ⋙
      (evaluation Cᵒᵖ AddCommGrpCat.{u}).obj (op U)) ≅
      (sheafToPresheaf J AddCommGrpCat.{u} ⋙
        (evaluation Cᵒᵖ AddCommGrpCat.{u}).obj (op U)).rightDerived q)
